f3_reclassification.root_cause_of_the_misdiagnosis: the run-001 diagnosis read the CALL SITE (ContentReviewService.java:869 questionVersions.findByPaperId(paperId)) and assumed a Spring Data DERIVED query (no ORDER BY = heap order). It never opened QuestionVersionRepository.java, where findByPaperId is an explicit @Query: 'select v from QuestionVersion v where v.question.examPaperId = :paperId order by v.question.externalRef nulls last, v.version desc'.
f3_reclassification.correction: the capture pins a DETERMINISTIC order; the PORT dropped the ORDER BY (both port query shapes: findFullByPaperId walk + findByPaperId id list). F-3 is an ordinary faithful port fix. The R6/R0 capture-stability ruling request is WITHDRAWN by this lane; R6's golden/** needs NOTHING (no case was over-pinned).
f3_reclassification.integrity_note: this correction is itself evidence for the run-001 harness doctrine: setcheck (multiset compare) was the right Triage tool only AFTER the ordering assumption was wrong; the repository-declaration read should have preceded the filing.

fixes.mechanism: createdAt serialization. Java Jackson JSR-310 renders Instant.toString(): the timestamp(6) fraction in 3-digit groups with TRAILING ZERO GROUPS OMITTED (.578011Z / .129Z / no fraction). The port mapped driver Date objects (JS Date = ms precision — DB micros destroyed at the boundary) through toISOString().
fixes.fix: queries now transport the fraction as Postgres TEXT: to_char(<col> at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as *_instant; new instantToStringUtc() applies the group rule (g1/g2 of the 6-digit fraction; g2=='000' -> 3 digits or none). Applied to documents (3 queries), exam_papers (4 queries), content_review_audit (1 query) — one shared writer, one law (audit occurredAt uses Instant.toString() explicitly in AuditRowView.from).
fixes.correction_within_the_fix: writer v1 trimmed INDIVIDUAL trailing zeros (produced .39523Z); the live run-002 deep-diff caught the capture pinning .395230Z on 101 listing rows — Instant.toString omits trailing zero GROUPS, not individual zeros. Corrected to group semantics in f26ba67 with the capture literals pinned as regression tests.

fixes.mechanism: CanonicalDocumentDto.java:13-14 (§8 ingestion contract): 'top-level camelCase, per-element snake_case' — element fields are page_number / reading_order (@JsonProperty at :105/:108/:121/:124/:138/:141/:155/:158; text is plain). The port read element.pageNumber/readingOrder — keys that do not exist in the stored jsonb — so the page filter matched nothing and every page rendered the honest-empty string.
fixes.fix: documentPageText reads the §8 keys (text/page_number/reading_order); the routes.test.ts unit pin re-pinned from the buggy camelCase shape to the contract shape.

fixes.mechanism: see f3_reclassification above — port dropped the frozen @Query's deterministic ORDER BY (external_ref nulls last, version desc).
fixes.fix: order by q.external_ref nulls last, v.version desc restored on BOTH port query shapes (findFullByPaperId, findByPaperId) — same clause the Java finder renders for every call site (:128 :369 :813 :869).
